definition.survival: 20 consecutive observe calls start from one initial state; the bridge is attached before the first call; after every call sc_bridge is the same object and the table digest is unchanged
definition.read_each_step: after every observe the bridge reads the 20 describe sentences at 40/40 and the zero lines at 0/0
definition.inert: a bridged trajectory and a no-bridge trajectory from the same initial state must have the same h/fast/nu_ema/coverage/prior hash after 20 observe calls
definition.parameters: no parameter moves and no parameter receives a gradient during the 20 forwards
definition.clear: clear_bridge returns sc_bridge to None, bridge_read answers no_bridge, and five more observes stay identical to the no-bridge run
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.survival: 20/20 steps keep sc_bridge; table digest equals the initial digest
criteria.read_each_step: each of the 20 steps reads 40/40 and 0/0
criteria.inert: bridged and no-bridge tensor hashes are equal after 20 steps
criteria.parameters: parameter hash equals the baseline; every parameter grad is None
criteria.clear: sc_bridge None; bridge_read no_bridge; five more steps stay equal to the no-bridge run
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.reporting: the bridge is a side table; this round measures survival, not coupling. A failure to survive would be reported as a structural defect, not hidden
